facts.fact: The Bank of Algeria's Monetary and Banking Council communiqué of 23 September 2026 applies regulation no. 25-02 on payment service providers, a class of actors created under Monetary and Banking Law no. 23-09, in authorising a firm to constitute itself.
facts.system: Loi n° 23-09 and Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers

facts.fact: The Council authorised Djezzy Payment Services, a subsidiary of telecom operator Optimum Telecom Algérie, to constitute itself as a payment service provider under regulation no. 25-02; this is authorisation of constitution, with an application for licensing (agrément) due within 12 months of notification.
facts.system: Règlement n° 25-02 on payment service providers
